summary: YPF S.A., the Argentine integrated energy company, filed a 6-K disclosing that it increased the maximum aggregate purchase price of its previously announced cash tender offers for two series of outstanding dollar Notes from U.S.$500 million to U.S.$1 billion, excluding accrued interest. The offers cover 6.950% Senior Notes due 2027 (U.S.$643.428 million outstanding; U.S.$1,017.50 per U.S.$1,000) and 2.500%/9.000% Step Up Amortizing Notes due 2029 (U.S.$640.999934 million amortized outstanding; U.S.$1,042.00 per U.S.$1,000). Here, a 6-K maps to a US Form 8-K. Offers expire September 16, 2026, 5:00 p.m. NYC time, subject to acceptance priority and proration.
